summary: Phase 5 browser verification. On startup the forked preview environment had NO postgres database — user 'roofspan' and database 'roofspan' were missing, causing the backend to hang at 'Waiting for application startup' (Alembic connect timeout) and cloudflare returning 502 for /api/*. I provisioned the DB via `CREATE USER roofspan WITH PASSWORD 'roofspan_local_pwd' CREATEDB; CREATE DATABASE roofspan OWNER roofspan;`, restarted supervisor -> backend Alembic migrations ran clean, seed_owner created pjacobsen@asgardsolution.io. Frontend (React on :3000) reached backend at /api/*. All Phase 1-5 browser flows verified as owner. Login page renders wordmark (/brand/roofspan-wordmark-dark.webp, 200) + background (/brand/roofspan-login-bg.png, 200); favicon (roofspan-favicon.png, 200) and apple-touch-icon (roofspan-appicon.png, 200) resolve; sidebar shows the RoofSpan app-icon. Sidebar nav renders with Administration section visible to owner. Admin Users, Roles, Audit Log, and Settings pages all load; Settings shows the three tabs: Integrations, Map Configuration, Company Profile. Map view mounts MapLibre canvas (WebGL). Leads list loads. Customers page loads and Add customer dialog opens. Finance shows Quotes + Invoices tabs. Jobs page renders (0 rows — fresh DB has no seed jobs). Inventory materials table loads. Created material TEST_UI_P5_Mat_1786167498 via material-dialog; duplicate case-variant (upper-cased) attempt was rejected with 409 and toast: "A material named 'TEST_UI_P5_MAT_1786167498' already exists" (guard OK). Adjust dialog (+5) applied successfully. PODialog (opened from Inventory > Purchase Orders > Create purchase order) renders with data-testid=po-dialog. ACCESSIBILITY: material-dialog aria-describedby=radix-:r24: (present), adjust-dialog aria-describedby=radix-:r27: (present), po-dialog aria-describedby=radix-:rk: (present). Because the fresh DB has no jobs, job-material-dialog and job's PODialog could NOT be exercised in-browser this session, but source review confirms <DialogDescription> is present in JobDetail.jsx job-material-dialog (line 148). Two `Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}` warnings STILL fire in the console — they do NOT come from the three in-scope dialogs (all now have descriptions), they come from create-customer-dialog (/app/frontend/src/pages/Customers.jsx L65) and save-territory-dialog (/app/frontend/src/pages/MapView.jsx L350), which do NOT render <DialogDescription>. No ResizeObserver warnings observed this run.

action_items: The forked preview container came up WITHOUT the postgres roofspan role/database — backend hung on Alembic connect and Cloudflare returned 502 for /api/*. Please add a first-run bootstrap (e.g. a small init script or an Alembic-side createdb check) that provisions the 'roofspan' role (pwd from env) and 'roofspan' database if missing. I performed this by hand this session so testing could proceed: `sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE USER roofspan WITH PASSWORD 'roofspan_local_pwd' CREATEDB;"` and `CREATE DATABASE roofspan OWNER roofspan;`.
Add <DialogDescription> (or an aria-describedby) to create-customer-dialog in /app/frontend/src/pages/Customers.jsx (line 65) to eliminate the remaining Radix a11y warning.
Add <DialogDescription> to save-territory-dialog in /app/frontend/src/pages/MapView.jsx (line 350) for the same reason.
(No re-test blocker for the three in-scope Phase-4 dialogs) — material-dialog, adjust-dialog and po-dialog all now expose aria-describedby correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Startup fragility: server.py on_startup relies on `run_migrations` succeeding, which requires the target DB to already exist. If the DB is absent (fresh fork), uvicorn stays in 'Waiting for application startup' forever without a clear error surface — supervisor keeps the process alive but the API is a black hole (502 through ingress). Consider (a) probing the DB in on_startup and printing an actionable error, (b) shipping a small bootstrap-postgres shell/py script, or (c) using an async_engine connect() with a fast timeout + explicit error log.

schemas_phase4.py line 159 previously had a syntax bug ('_SpecialGenericAlias object does not support item assignment') per stale backend.err.log — appears fixed in the current code but the log entry can confuse future debugging; consider log rotation.

context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) FRESH FORKS MISSING DB: If /api/* returns 502 and backend log shows 'Waiting for application startup' with no 'Application startup complete', check `sudo -u postgres psql -l` — if roofspan DB is absent, run: `sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE USER roofspan WITH PASSWORD 'roofspan_local_pwd' CREATEDB;"` then `CREATE DATABASE roofspan OWNER roofspan;` and `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`. 2) Two Radix a11y warnings that persist in console come from create-customer-dialog and save-territory-dialog (out of Phase-4 dialog scope). 3) In-scope Phase 4 dialogs (material, adjust, job-material, po, receive) all have DialogDescription per code review and confirmed at runtime for material/adjust/po. 4) The duplicate-material 409 guard works and surfaces the correct toast.
rca of the issue: Cloudflare 502 on preview URL for /api/* was caused by uvicorn stalling on Alembic which was itself stalling on connecting to a non-existent 'roofspan' postgres database in the forked container. Fix: manually created the postgres role and database matching backend/.env DATABASE_URL, restarted supervisor -> backend; Alembic ran migrations, seed_owner created the owner, API came up in <10s. Real remediation for main agent: add a DB-bootstrap step to the environment initialisation so forks self-heal.
